section_summary.extract_value: This section details the data analytic strategy for the current study, which involved hierarchical regression analyses. It describes the sequential entry of variables, including an experimental manipulation, cognitive ability, learning orientation, and performance orientation, followed by interaction terms. All variables were centered before creating interaction terms, and one-tailed tests of significance were used due to directional hypotheses.
